scene.note: Theo's tidying left names and values Node cannot use, so the sheet stops partway until you fix each one and it reaches Ines.

steps.note: Under Task 1, one line makes the count of wax jars and the next one prints it.
Node runs the lines in order and meets a name nothing has made.
The error names the name it does not know, and the mark sits under it.
Fixed, the sheet tells Ines how many jars of wax are left.
Under Task 2, the cedar count starts with the delivery and should then lose the sold candles.
Node stops on the line that changes the count, because of how the count was made.
Once the count can change, the sheet shows what is really left on the shelf.
Under Task 3, the label starts as the customer's name and should then turn into capitals.
Node reads the whole file first, finds one name made twice, and runs nothing at all.
That is why this error shows first, even though Task 3 sits lower in the file.
Fixed, the label comes out in capitals, ready for the parcel.
Under Task 4, the courier's city code is made in three jobs on one line.
One job on that line never runs, so the next one is asked of something that is not text.
The error names what is not a function. Each dot in that name is a place to look.
Fixed, the sheet prints the code the courier wants.
